scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning to use a washing machine, [X] separates familiar lower garments into light, dark, and saturated loads and treats dye transfer, fading, fabric weight, and the effort of maintaining color as consequences that can change which bottoms remain practical.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在学习使用洗衣机时，[X]会把熟悉的下装按浅色、深色和高饱和度分批处理，并把串色、褪色、面料重量以及维持颜色所需的精力视为会改变下装实用性的真实后果。
examples: sorting White, Ivory, Nude, Beige, Tan, Yellow, Pink, Coral, or light Gray bottoms with compatible light loads when visible dye transfer would be costly
washing Black, Navy, Charcoal, Brown, Olive, Burgundy, or Wine bottoms cold and inside out when preserving a dark finish matters
isolating new Blue, Green, Red, Purple, Orange, Khaki, Teal, or Turquoise bottoms until their colorfastness is understood rather than treating every colored garment alike

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a five-day trip through three Italian cities, [X] limits the suitcase to two long bottom garments and one warm-weather alternative, comparing colors by how well they repeat across museum days, church coverage, cobblestone walks, train transfers, changing weather, and a nicer dinner.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为期五天、途经三座意大利城市的旅行中，[X]把行李限制为两件长下装和一件暖天替代款，并比较不同颜色能否在博物馆参观、教堂着装、石板路步行、火车换乘、天气变化和较正式晚餐之间反复搭配。
examples: using Navy as a repeatable long-wear base when the capsule should look softer than all Black
using Black for the bottom category expected to move from transit to a dressier evening
using Beige, Tan, Khaki, White, or Gray only when repeated wear and expected weather make visible upkeep realistic

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the wedding party fixes one suit color for all groomsmen, [X] coordinates the trousers of the selected suit with the ceremony's formality, shirt, shoes, and accessories while keeping the group visually consistent in photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 婚礼团队为所有伴郎确定同一种西装颜色后，[X]会围绕这套已选西装的裤装，结合仪式正式度、衬衫、鞋履和配饰进行协调，同时维持集体合影中的视觉一致性。
examples: keeping Green or Olive trousers continuous with the selected army-green suit
using Black footwear and restrained accents without changing the fixed trouser color
comparing the selected earthy suit with a Charcoal or Black formal direction only when the couple reopens the group decision

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool, cloudy day, [X] builds a comfortable outfit around a familiar thin black bomber jacket and compares bottom colors by whether they preserve a deliberate dark silhouette, soften it, or introduce enough contrast without feeling out of place in overcast light.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在凉爽多云的一天，[X]会围绕熟悉的黑色薄款飞行夹克搭配舒适造型，并比较下装颜色是延续有意为之的深色轮廓、适度柔化整体，还是在阴天光线下提供不过分突兀的对比。
examples: using Black bottoms for a continuous monochrome base around the jacket
using Charcoal or dark Gray when the user wants separation without a sharp contrast
using dark Blue, Navy, Olive, or Khaki when the cloudy-day palette should stay muted but not monochrome

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing for a managerial interview, [X] narrows the lower half of a male business-formal outfit to colors that look composed while seated, coordinate with a plain shirt and polished shoes, and do not become the distracting element of the first impression.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在准备管理岗位面试时，[X]会把男士商务正装的下装颜色收窄到几种选择：坐下时仍显稳重、能与素色衬衫和擦亮的皮鞋协调，并且不会成为第一印象中分散注意力的部分。
examples: using Navy trousers as part of a conservative suit when the user wants a softer professional base
using Charcoal or dark Gray when restraint and easy shirt coordination matter
using Black only when the full outfit remains dimensional rather than reading as an undifferentiated dark block

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five women from a golf group, [X] creates an original dress theme using skirts, skorts, jeans, or coordinated short sets to make the palette recognizable in group photographs without requiring everyone to wear the same garment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫群体女性参加的户外午宴进行组织时，[X]会设计原创着装主题，通过半身裙、裙裤、牛仔裤或成套短装让配色在集体合影中清晰可辨，同时不要求所有人穿同一种衣服。
examples: using White, Ivory, Beige, Tan, Nude, or soft Gray bottoms for a light country-club direction
using Pink, Coral, Orange, Red, or Yellow when assigned color groups should read clearly in photographs
using Green, Teal, Turquoise, Blue, or Purple when a cool or jewel-toned group needs a distinct but wearable lane

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon campus reunion, [X] proposes wearing familiar dark jeans with a sweater and classic clogs, then checks whether that pair looks intentional enough for reconnecting with classmates while staying true to an everyday style.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加校园里的下午同学聚会时，[X]打算穿熟悉的深色牛仔裤、毛衣和经典洞洞鞋，并检查这条裤子能否在保持日常风格的同时，显得足够用心以适合与老同学重聚。
examples: keeping dark Blue or Navy denim when it is clean, unripped, and easy to coordinate with the sweater
using Black jeans when the user wants the same familiar formula to read slightly sharper
comparing Gray denim only if it remains as neat and intentional as the proposed dark pair

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a cold optometrist visit to try on luxury frames, [X] chooses warm, polished lower garments in understated colors so the face and eyewear remain easier to judge in indoor and natural light.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在寒冷天气前往验光师处试戴高端镜框时，[X]会选择保暖、利落且颜色低调的下装，使脸部和眼镜在室内光线与自然光下更便于观察和比较。
examples: using Black or dark Blue jeans when the visit should remain casual but refined
using Navy, Charcoal, or Gray tailored trousers for a cleaner luxury-oriented direction
using Beige trousers only when the rest of the winter outfit preserves sufficient visual focus around the face

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a specific game-character cosplay, [X] selects and modifies one pair of athletic leggings, checks the base and added thigh details against the reference, and keeps the garment practical enough to wear through a convention.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作特定游戏角色的 cosplay 时，[X]会挑选并改造一条运动紧身裤，对照角色参考核验底色与大腿处新增细节，同时保证这件衣物足够实用，能够在漫展期间持续穿着。
examples: using a dark Blue-Purple base when that is the recognizable lower-body color in the selected reference
adding White thigh details with paint or sewn panels rather than replacing the base color
rejecting a generic Black pair when it would erase the character-specific color relationship

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After sharing photographs of two previously worn outfits, [X] compares the trousers or skirt with the shoes and upper-body layers to see whether a continuous color line makes the body look taller, or whether a darker neutral base makes the lower half appear visually heavier.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在分享穿过的两套造型照片后，[X]会比较照片中的裤装或半身裙与鞋履、上身叠穿之间的关系，观察连贯配色是否更显高，以及较深的中性色下装是否会让下半身显得更沉重。
examples: keeping trousers and heels in the same color family when a continuous leg line is the priority
using Black, Navy, or Charcoal as the photographed lower-body base when the user prefers a visually quieter foundation
placing a bright color in an accessory instead of the bottom when uninterrupted vertical proportion matters more
